title: Court docs: OpenAI says Apple's ChatGPT integration to power Apple Intelligence on iPhones "dramatically underperformed" after it launched in 2024 (Michael Acton/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Acton / Financial Times: Court docs: OpenAI says Apple's ChatGPT integration to power Apple Intelligence on iPhones “dramatically underperformed” after it launched in 2024 — Court documents reveal how companies' ties unravelled while the iPhone maker has since turned to a Google-powered ‘Siri AI’
contentText:
Michael Acton / Financial Times :

Court docs: OpenAI says Apple's ChatGPT integration to power Apple Intelligence on iPhones “dramatically underperformed” after it launched in 2024   —  Court documents reveal how companies' ties unravelled while the iPhone maker has since turned to a Google-powered ‘Siri AI’
